marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Consists of 3 episodes: Friends in high places- Izzi is feeling blue. Although she appreciates the help from friends, Izzi wishes she could do things for herself. A mishap at the talent show might prove to be the perfect opportunity to shine! She discovers everyone is built for a purpose ; Heavenly event- Everyone is excited about the extraordinary meteor shower. As EJ leaves to watch the shower he has an injury that will cause him to miss out, unless, a true act of selfless generosity arrives ; Sunny side up? One small thought, three friendships! Can one small thought be enough to hold them together or what splits them apart?
